items.title: This week's publish board, 9 to 13 November
items.detail: Start on the Ideas tab: pick one idea each for Wednesday and Friday, four checked ideas a day. Monday is already made and recorded (Character.AI). Tick each step as you do it; every tick is saved at once, and the next session copies it onto the piece. The off-day options, your lock-down short among them with its script, are written but not on the board yet: the board refuses any off-day option until a code fix to its mix button lands.
